name: Patent by Ouroboros Apps
description: Patent by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). USPTO patent search and prior art lookup: search public patent records, fetch a patent, list citations, and run a prior-art search. Not legal advice. The hosted server searches the USPTO Open Data Portal; EPO Open Patent Services is not turned on. Tools: search_patents, get_patent, find_patent_citations, search_prior_art. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/patent. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/patent.
author: Ouroboros Apps
